values.summary: Implement and prove the deterministic WP-08 birth decision, including complete disqualifying cases and explicit public-claim boundaries.

steps.action: Verify #5817/#5801 terminal receipts and inspect adl-runtime-kernel contract/proof authorities before claiming the exact birthday.rs, lib.rs, tests, fixture, feature, and evidence paths.
Implement the versioned birth-decision contract, one valid fixture, and the complete table-driven disqualifier matrix.
Run deterministic focused, negative, path-hygiene, and public-claim boundary lanes and retain exact-revision evidence.
Resolve one bounded exact-head review and publish only with correct base and Closes #5825 linkage.

invariants: Birth decisions are deterministic over canonical inputs and fail closed on missing or contradictory evidence.
Startup, wake, restore, snapshot, copied state, migration, and admission are never sufficient birth evidence.
Existing v0.91.x birthday non-claims and downstream work-package authority remain unchanged.
risks: The birth decision could accept a lifecycle lookalike or incomplete evidence packet.
The shared adl-runtime-kernel/src/lib.rs registration could collide with adjacent sequential sprint work.
Claim-boundary prose could overstate personhood, citizenship, governance, migration, or launch readiness.
stop_conditions: WP-01/#5817 or WP-02A/#5801 terminal proof is stale, missing, or contradictory.
Execution requires paths outside birthday.rs, lib.rs registration, tests/birthday.rs, tests/fixtures/birthday/, the WP-08 feature contract, or .csdlc/evidence/5825/ without explicit replan.
Any declared negative case lacks deterministic fail-closed proof.
replan_triggers: The source contract changes required birth evidence or disqualifiers.
Execution requires a shared Runtime v3 schema change outside the exact declared paths.
A reviewer identifies an uncovered lifecycle lookalike or unsupported public claim.
